title: 第23章 有我在第24章 你们叶家连狗都不如
content_zh:
真武境武者的寿元，比普通凡人也强不了多少，顶多一百来年。
只有返璞归真，凝聚武道元丹突破玄武境，寿元才会暴涨翻倍。
叶震骁现在已经气血衰落，而且资质一般，今后几十年想突破玄武境根本不可能，若是能得到青冥大寿丹的二十年寿元，他便有很大的把握。
后悔的同时，他又感到无比愤怒。
苏尘这么做，明摆着实在羞辱他！
在他的思想认知中，他身为长辈，无论做了什么，晚辈都应该无条件的孝敬和服从！
可惜，苏尘却不惯着他。
早就想替苏尘出气的玄阳大师，更不会惯着他。
“既然尔等不信任老夫的丹道，那这颗精元化气丹还是还给老夫吧！
有眼无珠之辈，不配服用老夫炼制的丹药！”
玄阳大师冷哼一声，不等叶兴龙反应过来，伸手便将他手中的精元化气丹拿了回来。
看到这一幕，叶震骁更是心头滴血。
可他却不敢多说什么。
得罪玄阳大师的后果，他承受不起。
“苏尘不是丹田气海破碎，已经变成了废物了吗？”
“怎么能让这两尊大人物，如此的看重？”
叶德元、叶德明等人的脸色，都是瞬间变得无比难看了起来。
“苏尘那个废物，怎么会认识柳城主和玄阳大师？”
叶陵咬牙切齿，眼神中充满了嫉妒和怨毒。
“不用理会！

他丹田气海破碎，就算是玄阳大师也不可能为他修复，他不会对你造成任何的威胁！”
叶德元恢复冷静之后，对叶兴龙安慰道。
“不错！
这个世界终究是实力为尊，所谓的人脉关系、身份地位，在真正的实力面前，狗屁不如！
兴龙，只要你在武道院好好修行，未来便可将这些人统统踩在脚下。”
叶震骁充满期许的看着叶兴龙，郑重的说道：“爷爷相信你，也会全力帮助你！”
虽说如此，但看着老神在在的苏尘，他的眼神中还是有一丝寒意和愤怒闪过。
显示出了他的内心，并不像表面上那么平静。
“放心吧爷爷！
孙儿一定不负您的重托，必将踏上武道之巅，将这些人统统踩死！”
叶兴龙重新燃起了希望，盯着苏尘等人，恶狠狠的说道。
“好！
这才是我叶震骁的好孙子！
爷爷现在就将整个家族的大权交给你，今后所有的家族资源你都可以随意调用！”
说完，叶震骁带着叶兴龙转身走上大殿的高台。
“诸位！
今日虽是老夫大寿，但我叶家还有一件更大的喜事要宣布！”
叶震骁运气提高音量，中气十足的声音响彻整个叶家。
“还有大喜事？”
人们一下子来了兴趣。

看到众人的注意力，从苏尘那一桌上转了回来，叶震骁才神情一肃，语气激昂的说道：“老夫的长孙叶兴龙，已经通过王都武道院考核，并被武道院长老看重，收为弟子，未来必将成为一方强者，为我北荒城扬名立万！”
“果然加入了武道院吗？”
content_en:
The longevity of a True Martial Realm warrior is not much better than that of ordinary mortals, at most a hundred years.
Only by returning to one's original nature and condensing the martial arts Yuandan to break through the Xuanwu realm can one's longevity be doubled.
Ye Zhenxiao's vitality and blood are now declining, and his qualifications are average. It is impossible to break through the Xuanwu realm in the next few decades. If he can get the twenty-year longevity of Qingming's longevity pill, he will be very confident.
While he regretted it, he also felt extremely angry.
Su Chen clearly humiliated him by doing this!
In his thinking, as an elder, no matter what he does, the younger generation should unconditionally respect and obey!
It's a pity that Su Chen doesn't like him.
Master Xuanyang, who had long wanted to vent his anger on Su Chen, would not coddle him.
"Since you don't trust me in my alchemy, then you should return this Jingyuan Qi Pill to me!
A blind person is not worthy of taking the elixir I refined! "
Master Xuanyang snorted coldly, and before Ye Xinglong could react, he reached out and took back the Jingyuan Qi Transformation Pill in his hand.
Seeing this scene, Ye Zhenxiao's heart began to bleed.
But he didn't dare to say anything more.
He couldn't bear the consequences of offending Master Xuanyang.
"Isn't it true that Su Chen's Dantian Qi sea was shattered and turned into waste?"
"How can these two great figures be so valued?"
The faces of Ye Deyuan, Ye Deming and others instantly became extremely ugly.
"How could that loser Su Chen know City Lord Liu and Master Xuanyang?"
Ye Ling gritted his teeth, his eyes full of jealousy and resentment.
"Ignore it!
His Dantian Qi sea is broken, and even Master Xuanyang cannot repair it. He will not pose any threat to you! "
After Ye Deyuan regained his composure, he comforted Ye Xinglong.
"Not bad!
In this world, strength is valued after all. The so-called connections and status are nothing compared to real strength!
Xinglong, as long as you practice well in the martial arts academy, you can trample all these people under your feet in the future. "
Ye Zhenxiao looked at Ye Xinglong expectantly and said solemnly: "Grandpa believes in you and will do his best to help you!"
Even so, when looking at Su Chen with the old god here, there was still a hint of coldness and anger in his eyes.
It shows that his heart is not as peaceful as it appears.
"Don't worry, grandpa!
My grandson will definitely live up to your trust and will step onto the top of martial arts and trample all these people to death! "
Ye Xinglong regained his hope, stared at Su Chen and others, and said fiercely.
"Okay!
This is my great grandson, Ye Zhenxiao!
Grandpa will hand over the power of the entire family to you now, and you can use all family resources at will from now on! "
After saying that, Ye Zhenxiao and Ye Xinglong turned around and walked up to the high platform of the hall.
"Everyone!
Although today is my birthday, my Ye family has an even bigger happy event to announce! "
Ye Zhenxiao luckily raised his voice, and his powerful voice resounded throughout the Ye family.
"Is there any big happy event?"
People were suddenly interested.
Seeing everyone's attention turned back from Su Chen's table, Ye Zhenxiao looked solemn and said in an excited tone: "My eldest grandson, Ye Xinglong, has passed the examination of the Royal Capital Martial Arts Academy, and has been valued by the martial arts academy elders and accepted as a disciple. He will definitely become a strong man in the future and make a name for our Beihuang City!"
"Did you really join the Martial Academy?"
